## Summary

## Decisions

- **Lazy Supabase admin client initialization inside handler**: Prevents static page collection failures during production build when runtime secrets are not yet injected.
- **Automatic deletion of 404/410 response targets**: Keeps the push_subscriptions database clean when devices unsubscribe or tokens expire.
